_note: The sound registry (pepin.sounds): the sounds the robot may play through the board's audio server, by name. No audio file is tracked (sounds/ is gitignored): a private tree keeps its files under its own sounds/ and its own copy of this file, which pepin.overlay merges over this one by name (an entry of the same name replaces this one whole, a new name is appended). An entry: name (a mark's argument, {sound:NAME}), file (relative to sounds/ in any tree; null until the file is dropped in: python -m pepin.overlay --check lists those), start_s (where the cut begins in the file), seconds (how much plays, a hard cut at the end), description (at most six words: the brain's list), style (the dance family of animation.json dances its variants of this argument; a style the family lacks moves nothing), beats (null, or the cut's grid: bpm, times_s in the FILE's seconds, strengths 0..1, method; a recording's from pepin.sounds.beat_grid, a synthesized sound's by construction), external (true: fetched separately, never on disk here), synthesized (true: pepin.sounds makes the file under the public tree's sounds/ on first use, or python -m pepin.sounds --make-default) and a note. The public registry holds one sound, default_beat: a 4-bar drum loop at 120 BPM made from numpy (no third-party audio), its beat every 0.5 s from 0, rock its style. pulse: the body on a sound's beats (pepin.expression.listeners.MusicPulse): strong (0.6, 0..1): a beat's strength from which every free part dances, under it the head and the face alone; lead_s (1.3, 0.3..3): the player tells each beat this long before it sounds; it covers the dance's slowest preparation with its part's latency (rock's raise to raised, 1.1 s before its beat, plus the arm's 0.06: at 1.0 the arm at rest never rose for it, 2026-10-14; tests/unit/test_sounds.py holds every step to it); lead_min_s (0.25, 0.1..1): a beat told nearer than this is skipped. player: the sound player (pepin.sound_player: the cut through the voice's own stream, speech winning over it), read at every play: fade_s (0.2, 0..1): the ramp to silence speech, a stop or a newer sound cuts a sound with (what was sent, up to the voice's lead, plays out first); wait_s (30, 0..120): how long a sound asked while a reply is in flight waits for it to end before it is dropped.

sounds.name: default_beat

beats.method: synthesized: a beat every 0.5 s from 0 (pepin.sounds.default_beat)

sounds.note: made by pepin.sounds (python -m pepin.sounds --make-default, or on first use): 16 kHz mono, 8 s; a kick on 1 and 3, a snare on 2 and 4, a closed hat every eighth; the grid is the recipe's own, every beat at pulse.strong or over, so the whole body dances
